standard_prerequisites.name: Semistandard Young tableaux, convergent string rewriting, rational transductions, padding regularity and Squier coherence
standard_prerequisites.statement: Original finite ordered alphabet, height bound, column product and all normalization/transducer definitions retained verbatim. Prior commutative/cancellative/PBW results are expressly attributed in original introduction105--124 and remain background.
standard_prerequisites.use: Complete original source-local convergence, multiplier construction and bounded critical branching proofs supplied; cited general rewriting and rational-to-regular theorems are standard prerequisites.

core_obligations: The author proves convergence by a well-founded padded-column order and identifies the precise tableau normal forms, then constructs finite-state right-multiplication transducers using a single right-to-left normalization pass and derives all four padded multiplier regularity conditions. The bounded three-step critical-branching diagrams supply the coherent extension. This coordinated rewriting/automata/polygraphic construction is retained as one principal presentation object, rather than counting its standard finiteness, PBW, word-problem and categorical-action consequences separately.
